instrument_name: DOL OUI Comparison of State UI Laws 2023 Ch.1 Coverage, Location of Employment / Localization of Work
figure_or_rule_carried: Localization provisions (model legislation put into all state UI laws in the 1940s) apply in order: (1) service localized in this state or another; (2) if not localized, some service in the state of the base of operations (place from which the individual starts work and customarily returns for instructions); (3) else some service in the state from which service is directed or controlled; (4) else some service in the state where the individual lives. Edition reflects state law as of 2023-01-01; 2024-2026 editions not found at the expected URLs (404). UIPL 20-04 cited for telecommuting.
